seleccion.titulo: Advancing cardiac xenotransplantation: overcoming challenges and ethical considerations for clinical integration
seleccion.resumen_previo: Revisión que sintetiza los desafíos científicos e inmunológicos del xenotrasplante cardíaco, desde la escasez de órganos humanos hasta el rol de CRISPR y nuevas estrategias de inmunosupresión. Proporciona contexto actualizado sobre cómo la edición génica abre caminos para la integración clínica de esta alternativa.
seleccion.extracto: Advanced heart failure affects over 6 million adults in the United States alone. Orthotopic heart transplantation remains the definitive treatment, with over 90% one-year survival and meaningful gains in functional status and quality of life. The therapy is, however, constrained by an intractable supply problem. For decades, xenotransplantation (XTx), the transplantation of organs across species, has been proposed as a means of closing this gap, though for most of that time it remained a theoretical aspiration. El avance permite evaluar la viabilidad de órganos marginales y potencialmente modificarlos ex vivo antes del trasplante.

seleccion.extracto: Extracellular vesicles (EV) secreted by living cells are important players in cell-to-cell communication, particularly in the diffuse immune system, where they contribute to local and systemic coordination. Indeed, EV are in the ideal size range for diffusion in interstitial and lymphatic fluids, which is the main route of tissue EV trafficking towards secondary lymphoid organs that orchestrate immune responses. seleccion.titulo: Organoids: Current Applications and Future Directions
seleccion.resumen_previo: Una revisión examina los organoides como plataformas tridimensionales derivadas de células madre para estudiar desarrollo, enfermedad y medicina regenerativa. Aunque reconoce limitaciones actuales en maduración y vascularización, destaca su potencial para aplicaciones clínicas incluyendo modelos previos a xenotrasplante.
seleccion.extracto: Organoids are three-dimensional multicellular structures derived from stem cells or primary tissues that recapitulate key structural and functional features of native organs. Advances in stem cell biology, biomaterials, and bioengineering have established organoids as powerful platforms for studying human development and disease mechanisms, drug discovery, precision medicine, and regenerative medicine. descartados.titulo: Megakaryocytes in myelofibrosis: mechanisms of fibrotic niche remodeling and therapeutic implications
descartados.extracto: Myelofibrosis is a clonal myeloproliferative neoplasm characterized by progressive remodeling of the bone marrow microenvironment. Megakaryocyte (MK) abnormalities are defining histological features of prefibrotic and overt primary myelofibrosis and contribute to disease pathogenesis. Dysplastic MKs can directly modify the pericellular extracellular matrix (ECM), but their main fibrogenic influence comes from coordinating stromal, immune, and endothelial responses. This Review synthesizes evidence linking abnormal MK biology to fibrotic progression and examines its implications for biomarkers
